name: Ro65-6570
summary: Ro65-6570 is an opioid drug. It has a potential use in preventing the addiction to other opioids.

pharmacology.text: Ro65-6570 is an opioid drug, it works by activating opioid receptors. However, instead of acting at the mu, kappa and delta receptors, it is instead an agonist at the nociceptin receptor.

uses.text: It has a potential use in preventing the addiction to other opioids.

fact.en: Like Ro64-6198, it targets the nociceptin receptor. Animal work suggests such drugs can reduce the rewarding effects of other opioids, which is why they have been studied for addiction.
fact.zh: 和 Ro64-6198 一樣，它作用於痛敏肽受體。動物研究顯示，這類藥物可能降低其他鴉片類藥物的獎賞效果，因此被研究用於成癮治療。
fact.zhHans: 和 Ro64-6198 一样，它作用于痛敏肽受体。动物研究显示，这类药物可能降低其他鸦片类药物的奖赏效果，因此被研究用于成瘾治疗。
